title: Uncontracted centered normalized tower recovery comparisons and canonical local tests
statement:
Let $T=(T_i,J_i,b_i)_{0\le i\le n}$ be a centered normalized blowup tower with Noetherian stages [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization], with the stage composites $t_i:T_i\to T_0$, center-preserving maps and center-preserving isomorphisms of [def-per-normalized-tower-descent-data]. Define $\operatorname{Ass}(T)=\bigcup_{i<n}(t_i\circ V(J_i)\hookrightarrow T_i)(\operatorname{Ass}(V(J_i)))$, using associated points [def-sc-associated-points]. The closed center has structure sheaf $\mathcal O_{T_i}/J_i$.

For towers T,S of lengths n,m and base maps $b_T:T_0\to X$, $b_S:S_0\to X$, define $\operatorname{SameOver}(T,S,b_T,b_S)$ to mean $n=m$ together with a center-preserving stage isomorphism $E:T\simeq S$ satisfying $b_SE_0=b_T$; only transport of the finite index type is allowed, with no contraction. For $f:Y\to X$, a scheme-theoretic uncontracted pullback of $(T,b_T)$ is a length-n normalized tower R, an isomorphism $e:R_0\simeq Y$, and a cartesian center-preserving map $c:R\to T$, with $b_Tc_0=fe$. This is comparison data; existence is not asserted for arbitrary f.

For a geometric point $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, let $H_s$ be the recorded geometric strict local ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], with canonical evaluation $\epsilon_s:H_s\to\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation]. Put $C_s=\operatorname{AdicCompletion}_{\ker\epsilon_s}(H_s)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]; the kernel is the strict local maximal ideal. Define its structural morphism as $\operatorname{Spec}C_s\to\operatorname{Spec}H_s\to X$, using the actual completion map and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Finally define $X_{\mathbf Q}\to X$ to be the first projection of $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q$, using the canonical structural ring maps. No openness is part of this definition.
